scope: Corollary 3.6 (The uncapped row functional) of the manuscript “Microscopic jamming in the negative spherical perceptron” (preprints/Microscopic-jamming-in-the-negative-spherical-perceptron-September-24-2026/Microscopic-jamming-in-the-negative-spherical-perceptron-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 222 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8d94e973e689e60b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Fix β > 0 and ψ ∈ C∞ c (R). There are constants cβ > 0 and d0 = d0(β, ψ) > 0 such that, for ud = −βV + dψ, |d| ≤ d0, Q ∈ [1/2, 2], and all q, r ∈ QQ, Φud ((1−t)q+tr; Q) ≥ (1−t)Φud (q; Q)+tΦud (r; Q)+ cβ 4 t(1−t)∥r−q∥2 2, 0 ≤ t ≤ 1. (3.19) When d = 0, the last coefficient can be replaced by cβ/2. The derivative formula (2.6), including its one-sided endpoint interpretation, holds with the terminal ud and fixed diagonal Q. Its nonnegative nondecreasing derivative profile satisfies supq,Q,d ∥Dud q ∥∞ ≤ Cβ,ψ in these ranges and depends continuously on q in L1 at fixed Q, d. The functional values and derivative profiles are limits of those for uL,δ + dψ, uniformly over q, Q, d, with derivative convergence in L1(ds). Here δ ↓ 0 at each fixed cap before L → ∞.
